**Description**
---------------

**Technical Project Manager**

*Distributed systems | High-volume data pipeline | Intelligence Platform*

**Function**

Energy DU

**Reports to**

Delivery Manager

**Employment type**

Full-time

**Location**

Trivandrum

**Team**

NeST Digital

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Own end-to-end technical delivery** across development, integration, testing, deployment and pilot phases, maintaining the integrated delivery plan, milestones and phase-gate sign-offs.
* **Coordinate cross-functional engineering workstreams** across frontend, backend, data/AI, OT/IoT integration, DevOps, QA and on-site deployment, ensuring dependencies and interfaces are actively managed.
* **Drive execution and delivery cadence** through sprint planning, stand-ups, technical reviews, milestone reviews and action tracking; proactively remove blockers and escalate critical risks.
* **Manage programme risks, dependencies and changes**, maintaining the risk/issue register, mitigation ownership, resource risks and formal change-control process against the approved MVP scope.
* **Manage pilot and deployment readiness** including site readiness, data audits, integration dependencies, hardware/software gaps, environment readiness and customer onboarding milestones.
* **Provide clear technical programme reporting** to Product Owners, Product Managers and Leadership, covering progress, schedule, risks, dependencies, quality, resource status and key decisions.

**Technical Skills**
====================

**Mandatory**

**Technical Delivery Management**

* **Strong experience managing complex software/technology delivery programmes** involving multiple engineering teams and interdependent workstreams.
* Understanding of **software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum delivery, CI/CD, testing, release management and production deployment**.
* Ability to understand technical dependencies across **application, API, data, AI/ML, infrastructure and integration layers**.
* Experience managing **delivery schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, resources and scope/change control**.
* Working understanding of **cloud-based software development and modern software architectures**.

**Technical Architecture Awareness**

* **Working understanding of distributed systems, microservices/service-oriented architecture and event-driven systems**.
* Understanding of **data pipelines, APIs, databases and high-volume data processing** sufficient to identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and integration issues.
* Ability to engage effectively with architects and engineering leads and **challenge/validate technical delivery assumptions**.

**Project & Programme Tools**

* Hands-on familiarity with project delivery and collaboration tools such as **Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet or equivalent**.
* Ability to maintain **delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, resource plans, dashboards and executive status reports**.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to **full-stack technologies** such as React/Angular, Java/.NET/Node.js/Python and SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Experience with **high-volume data pipelines, telemetry/time-series systems or data platforms**.
* Familiarity with **Kafka, MQTT or equivalent event/messaging technologies**.
* Experience with **Docker, Kubernetes/container orchestration and cloud platforms** such as AWS, Azure or equivalent.
* Exposure to **ThingsBoard, IoT, OT, SCADA or industrial data platforms**.
* Familiarity with **ML/AI and GenAI delivery lifecycle**, including model/data dependencies and AI solution integration.
* Experience managing **on-premise + cloud/hybrid deployments** and site-level technical integration.
* Experience in any of **Energy, Industrial Power and Oil & Gas** with leading a **software team**.
  

**Qualifications**
==================

**Mandatory**

* **9+ years of experience** in technical project/programme management or software delivery management.
* Proven experience **delivering complex software/platform programmes** with multiple technical workstreams and fixed milestones.
* Experience coordinating **cross-functional engineering teams** across development, QA, DevOps, data/integration and deployment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage **schedule, scope, risks, dependencies, resources and delivery governance**.
* Experience operating with **formal milestone/phase-gate or equivalent delivery governance** and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Strong **technical communication skills**, with the ability to translate engineering progress, risks and dependencies into clear business-level reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering**, Computer Science or a related technical discipline**.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering **IoT, SaaS, data platforms, telemetry platforms or distributed systems**.
* Experience with **ThingsBoard, industrial IoT, SCADA or OT integration**.
* Experience managing programmes involving **cloud + on-premise/hybrid infrastructure and container orchestration**.
* Experience working with **lean, startup-speed engineering teams** with dedicated project headcount and aggressive MVP timelines.
* Exposure to **customer-site deployments, pilot programmes, data audits and hardware/software integration**.
